newsitem.title: CHINA: China downplays free HK press, independent courts.
newsitem.headline: China downplays free HK press, independent courts.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin said a free Hong Kong press and independent courts had not played a significant role in the British colony's development, the official Xinhua news agency reported on Friday.

"Hong Kong's prosperity in the past cannot be attributed... to an independent judiciary and a free system of the press, but mainly to the creativity of the Hong Kong people," Xinhua quoted Jiang as saying.
Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997.
Many residents of Hong Kong say they fear Beijing will stifle freedom of expression in the territory after the handover.
"After the return of Hong Kong to the motherland, the people of Hong Kong will surely create a more prosperous Hong Kong with the attitude of the masters of the country," Jiang said.
